name: Dataflows - New Destination: PowerPoint Presentations (PPTX)
description: We plan to introduce PowerPoint Presentations (PPTX) as a new data destination for Dataflow Gen2, enabling customers to turn data prepared in Microsoft Fabric into presentation files using the low-code Power Query experience.Designed for citizen users, this destination brings prepared data into a familiar tool for communicating business results. It helps teams move from data transformation to stakeholder presentations, making it easier to share results through the PowerPoint documents they already use. Key benefits and scenarios:* Create data-driven presentations: Generate PowerPoint files from Dataflow Gen2 results for business reviews, operational updates, and team briefings.* Reuse preparation logic: Build presentation outputs on existing queries and transformations rather than preparing the same data separately.* Reduce manual handoffs: Simplify the process of moving prepared data into presentations.* Work in a familiar format: Deliver PowerPoint documents that business users can open, review, and share with colleagues.During Preview, customers can evaluate PowerPoint document generation in their workflows and share feedback to help refine the experience.

result.nameEs: Dataflows: nuevo destino Presentaciones de PowerPoint (PPTX)
result.descriptionEs: Dataflow Gen2 podrá generar archivos de PowerPoint a partir de datos preparados en Fabric para revisiones de negocio, actualizaciones operativas o reuniones, reutilizando consultas existentes y reduciendo el trabajo manual. Estará disponible en Preview.
